description: Anonymized responses of the six subject-matter experts (E1-E6) to the two-part DADE instrument (Tally, September 2026). Names and affiliations were collected only to verify participation and are not included.
pair_order: 21 pairs (i<j) in criteria_order: TS-AC, TS-BI, TS-HI, TS-RTO, TS-RPO, TS-MLS, AC-BI, AC-HI, AC-RTO, AC-RPO, AC-MLS, BI-HI, BI-RTO, BI-RPO, BI-MLS, HI-RTO, HI-RPO, HI-MLS, RTO-RPO, RTO-MLS, RPO-MLS
scale: Slider 1-9: 5 = equal importance; values below 5 favour the first criterion of the pair, values above 5 favour the second. Distance d = |v - 5| maps to Saaty intensity {0:1, 1:3, 2:5, 3:7, 4:9}.
